findings.reasoning: The function allows any caller to push arbitrary values into the private bonusCodes array, giving unrestricted write access to contract storage.
Anyone can call this function to shrink the bonusCodes array, potentially causing underflow and corrupting the array length.
When the array is empty, decrementing bonusCodes.length underflows the unsigned integer, setting the length to a huge value and breaking subsequent logic.
The function lacks any authorization check, so any user can overwrite entries in the bonusCodes array.
